'''Lord Khreusis's stronghold''' was a fortification, located high on the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], owned by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Khreusis|Lord Khreusis]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He stole the ancient Sith Lord [[Aloysius Kallig]]'s mask but it was later recovered by Kallig's [[Darth Nox|descendant]], who was still a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], after defeating Khreusis in a brief duel.
